item.title: Augusta homeless man takes bike from victim – at gunpoint!
item.description: A homeless Augusta man was armed with a revolver Saturday afternoon when he robbed a man of his bicycle behind the Dollar General on Peach Orchard Road, authorities say. The post Augusta homeless man takes bike from victim – at gunpoint! appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Purdy, 49ers eliminate defending Super Bowl champion Eagles with 23-19 win in wild-card game
item.description: Brock Purdy threw a go-ahead 6-yard touchdown pass to Christian McCaffery late in the fourth quarter, San Francisco used a trick play on a TD toss from wide receiver Jauan Jennings, and the 49ers eliminated the defending Super Bowl champion Philadelphia Eagles with a 23-19 wild-card victory Sunday. The post Purdy, 49ers eliminate defending Super Bowl champion Eagles with 23-19 win in wild-card game appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Georgia rallies past South Carolina 75–70
item.description: Georgia overcame a six-point halftime deficit and closed strong down the stretch to defeat South Carolina 75–70 on Saturday afternoon at Colonial Life Arena in Columbia, handing the Gamecocks their second straight SEC loss. The post Georgia rallies past South Carolina 75–70 appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County students earn spots in district spelling bee
item.description: Dozens of Columbia County elementary and middle school students will advance to the district-wide spelling bee after earning top honors at their school-level competitions. The post Columbia County students earn spots in district spelling bee appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: More candidates for Augusta mayor, commission emerge
item.description: Candidates are lining up to run the local government, with a third now pursuing the Augusta mayor’s office and competitive races for three Augusta Commission seats. The post More candidates for Augusta mayor, commission emerge appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Locals demonstrate against ICE over the weekend
item.description: Sunday proved a fervent day of protest many Augustans as several organizations cooperated to launch demonstrations opposing Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and the Trump administration in the wake of the fatal shooting of Renee Nicole Good by an ICE agent in Minneapolis last Wednesday. The post Locals demonstrate against ICE over the weekend appeared first on The Augusta Press.
